changelog: Virtual TV 2.0.1 adds per-channel Standard TV broadcast quality (480p, 720p or 1080p), a Clone Channel action that opens a new pre-filled channel without copying its schedule, and Android TV compatibility handling for Standard TV Record-to-Play-from-Beginning. Existing Standard TV channels retain the historical 720p setting until edited; new channels default to 1080p in the editor. Personalized TV scheduling and playback rules are unchanged.
description: Virtual linear TV channels generated from media already available in Jellyfin.
name: Virtual TV
